summary: A Yes vote revises the City of Milpitas business tax structure.

tax.text: A Yes vote updates the business tax and provides approximately $3 million annually for general city services without increasing taxes on residents.
tax.quote: providing approximately $3,000,000 annually for general city services such as maintaining fiscal stability, neighborhood safety/cleanliness

tax.text: A No vote leaves the existing business tax in place and does not provide the proposed additional annual revenue for city services.
